base_member_text: [L278,L403-L410] (MED/saved lifecycle state) The saved firstship flag is cleared permanently after one call and has no reset path, so a subsequent simulation in the same process will skip its required initial surface adjustment.
audit_member_text: [L278,L403-L410] (LOW/cross-instance persistent state) The saved firstship flag is never reset by ship_init, so a second model lifecycle in the same process will skip its initial water-level adjustment.

adversarial.rationale: firstship is a procedure-saved flag and ship_init does not reset it. A subsequent model instance in the same process therefore skips the adjustment even when its ship and water-level state have been freshly initialized.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex independent skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L210-L216,L297-L304] (MED/angular interpolation) Heading is represented as a wrapped angle and then interpolated linearly without unwrap handling, so tracks crossing the angle branch cut can rotate through the long arc.
audit_member_text: [L297-L304] (MED/angular interpolation) Heading is linearly interpolated as an ordinary scalar after conversion to radians, with no unwrap handling for tracks that cross the 0/360-degree discontinuity.

adversarial.rationale: Both supplied headings and headings derived with atan2 can straddle an angular branch cut. Their scalar linear interpolation has no unwrap or shortest-angle correction, so the intermediate ship orientation can rotate through the opposite direction.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex independent skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L314-L315,L348-L350,L442-L446] (HIGH/coordinate-frame inconsistency) Hull rotation and force moments subtract ship-local xCG/yCG values from globally positioned x/y coordinates, causing lever arms and rotated elevations to depend on the domain origin.
audit_member_text: [L346-L350,L442-L443] (HIGH/coordinate-frame inconsistency) World-coordinate ship-grid positions are combined with ship-local xCG/yCG when computing hull rotations and roll/pitch moments, making results depend on the global coordinate origin.

adversarial.rationale: xCG/yCG remain in the ship-local frame while the moment calculation subtracts them from transformed grid coordinates. The position/heading transformation is applied to the hull coordinates but not to that moment origin, so a translated or rotated ship has an inconsistent lever arm.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex independent skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L167-L176,L208-L217] (HIGH/out-of-bounds input case) A track with fewer than two records is accepted by count_lines, but automatic heading calculation unconditionally accesses records 1 and 2 and the final record minus one.
audit_member_text: [L167-L176,L210-L216] (HIGH/unchecked input length) When heading is derived, the code unconditionally accesses track samples 1 and 2 (and the final sample's predecessor), so a track with fewer than two records is out of bounds.

adversarial.rationale: The motion file record count is used without a minimum of two. The heading and interpolation logic nevertheless accesses adjacent records, and count_lines does not impose the required minimum, so empty or one-record files reach invalid indices.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex independent skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L130-L163,L330-L368] (HIGH/uninitialized hull state) When compute_motion is enabled, zhull is not initialized, yet shipwave reads it to compute pressure before the later placeholder motion update; with compute_force disabled it is never updated at all.
audit_member_text: [L130-L160,L330-L358] (HIGH/uninitialized hull state) For compute_motion=1, zhull is allocated but not initialized before it is used to compute pressure and force; the hull geometry update occurs only afterward.

adversarial.rationale: With imposed motion enabled, zhull has no guaranteed initialization before the force branch consumes it. The later assignment does not protect that earlier read, and the force-disabled path also uses it without establishing an initial hull elevation.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex independent skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L314-L315] (LOW/integer-centering ambiguity) The local-grid origin uses integer division nx/2 and ny/2, producing an asymmetric set of coordinates for odd grid dimensions.
audit_member_text: [L314-L315] (LOW/grid centering) Integer division nx/2 and ny/2 makes odd-sized ship grids asymmetric about the declared center of gravity.

base_member_text: [L116-L119,L305,L314-L315,L372-L373] (MED/degenerate-grid input) Ship-grid dx and dy permit zero, yet they define all coordinates and the cell area passed to grmap2, so a configured zero spacing creates a collapsed mapping grid.
audit_member_text: [L116-L119,L305,L314-L315,L372-L373] (MED/degenerate geometry input) dx and dy accept zero even though they define ship-grid coordinates and the area supplied to grmap2, allowing a degenerate mapping grid.

adversarial.rationale: The hull-grid spacing read has no positive-spacing validation before geometry/mapping calculations. A zero spacing can produce a collapsed grid and invalid division or mapping; no supplied caller substitutes a nonzero value.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex independent skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L223-L240,L339-L350] (HIGH/uninitialized motion state) shipphi, shipchi, and shippsi are allocated but not initialized, while the unimplemented motion branch immediately uses shipchi and shipphi to position the hull.
audit_member_text: [L223-L240,L346-L350] (HIGH/uninitialized motion state) shipphi, shipchi, and shippsi are allocated without initialization, while shipphi and shipchi are consumed during the first motion-enabled hull update.

adversarial.rationale: The relevant ship orientation state is allocated but not initialized by ship_init, and no other supplied writer establishes shipphi/shipchi before the force update reads them. Initializing other ship fields does not define these components.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex independent skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L98-L145,L172-L176,L223-L258] (MED/lifecycle/allocation) ship_init allocates the ship pointer graph and global ship arrays without an allocated/associated guard or teardown, making repeated initialization unsafe.

[L101-L107,L149-L156,L169-L206] (LOW/file-error handling) Ship-list, geometry, and track opens and reads have no visible status checks here, so malformed or short input depends entirely on helper-side termination behavior.

audit_member_text: [L333-L358] (MED/time-level inconsistency) For motion-enabled ships, pressure forces are computed from the previous hull position and only then is zhull updated, creating a one-step geometry/force lag even after initialization.

[L434-L446] (LOW/quadrature inconsistency) Vertical force uses only ph(ix,iy) per panel while horizontal forces average edge pressures, introducing a directional inconsistency in pressure integration.
